then we were trying to going ahead for our next version, it means that V2.0 it's going to have those features that are mentioned in thread:
[https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/discussion/4727-art_rate-project-v20](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/discussion/4727-art_rate-project-v20)
I would say that the proposal is still very long and hard to understand.

Hey - so given recent experience, if your total funding request is $10k but split into two $5k milestones, it makes sense to do two separate treasury proposals, else when you get the the second milestone, there will likely not be $5k - it'll either be less or more... 

[@Shankar Warang](/edgeware/account/jA7pLH65zgRNA4UgwqHEWWRxTgg51wuAUgfzmZoYWM2dMVS) thoughts?
They already split the proposal into 2 milestones. Treasury proposal #55 which is currently in the external queue is only for milestone 1.
Got it - so there would be a new proposal for milestone 2?
